name: Echt-Susteren (Netherlands)
description: A white saltire divides the flag into four triangles: blue at top and bottom, each charged with a white lozenge, and red at hoist and fly, each charged with a gold crosslet.
history: Flag of the municipality of Echt-Susteren in the province of Limburg, formed in 2003.

features.role: a white saltire dividing the flag into four triangles — blue at top and bottom, red at hoist and fly
two gold crosslets (hoist and fly triangles)
two white lozenges (top and bottom triangles)
